status: predeclared analysis of already observed pilot structures; not a blinded prospective experimental panel or a production ceiling decision
symmetry: conservative canonical Amber heavy-graph automorphisms preserving element, force-field type, charge, bonded hydrogen degree, and N/CA/C/O/OXT/CB names; no HIS tautomer guessing
metric: minimum maximum heavy displacement over complete allowed automorphisms; exact-name metrics retained alongside
quality_control: recompute original exact comparisons and bond/chirality findings; retain source-defect strata rather than filtering them into a clean pooled quantile
constraints: 36 factorial triplets, not one common scaling factor
all 5 original strata retained and reported separately
symmetry unavailable is explicit, never a zero movement or silently passing result
compare symmetry and exact metrics only on the same available subset
no coordinate optimization, atom renaming in experimental bytes, sampling, or production limit change
contact metrics remain exact-name descriptive controls; symmetry-corrected movement alone does not establish contact/density support
two proteins and correlated residues do not establish general uncertainty or interface qualification
